## MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
RISK-ON regime: low volatility 18.5% and mixed breadth 4/8 sectors positive; environment favors risk assets and momentum. Volatility: 18.5%, Breadth: 4/8.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy & Chemicals leading: TUPRS (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +29.33%) ABOVE TREND, TRALT (1W: +15.52% | 1M: +7.91%) ABOVE TREND. Retail & Food also strong: SOKM (1W: +11.95% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND, BIMAS (1W: +11.14% | 1M: +6.66%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology & Telecom and Transportation lag: KONTR (1W: -7.36% | 1M: -25.00%) BELOW TREND, THYAO (1W: -1.39% | 1M: -3.76%) BELOW TREND. Banking shows strain: ISCTR (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -4.69%) BELOW TREND.

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
TRALT (1W: +15.52% | 1M: +7.91%) ABOVE TREND, GUBRF (1W: +13.48% | 1M: +11.94%) ABOVE TREND, TRMET (1W: +13.19% | 1M: +7.02%) ABOVE TREND, TUPRS (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +29.33%) ABOVE TREND, SOKM (1W: +11.95% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
VESTL (1W: -1.08% | 1M: -9.61%) BELOW TREND, ISCTR (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -4.69%) BELOW TREND, THYAO (1W: -1.39% | 1M: -3.76%) BELOW TREND, PGSUS (1W: -1.45% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND, SASA (1W: -2.93% | 1M: -12.45%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
High short-term momentum in Energy and Retail: TRALT (1W: +15.52% | 1M: +7.91%) ABOVE TREND, GUBRF (1W: +13.48% | 1M: +11.94%) ABOVE TREND, TRMET (1W: +13.19% | 1M: +7.02%) ABOVE TREND, TUPRS (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +29.33%) ABOVE TREND, BIMAS (1W: +11.14% | 1M: +6.66%) ABOVE TREND.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Mixed to cautious: AKBNK (1W: +1.31% | 1M: +3.95%) ABOVE TREND, GARAN (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +3.92%) CORRECTION, ISCTR (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -4.69%) BELOW TREND, YKBNK (1W: -0.90% | 1M: +5.53%) CORRECTION.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy industry showing rotation: KRDMD (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND, EREGL (1W: +2.03% | 1M: -13.71%) RECOVERY, FROTO (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +1.01%) ABOVE TREND, ARCLK (1W: -2.99% | 1M: -6.57%) BELOW TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Clear leadership but bifurcated: TUPRS (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +29.33%) ABOVE TREND, TRALT (1W: +15.52% | 1M: +7.91%) ABOVE TREND, TRMET (1W: +13.19% | 1M: +7.02%) ABOVE TREND, PETKM (1W: +7.41% | 1M: -8.78%) RECOVERY, SASA (1W: -2.93% | 1M: -12.45%) BELOW TREND.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Overweight cyclicals and momentum within Energy & Chemicals, Retail and select Holding names; trim Technology and Transportation exposure. Keep cash buffer for volatility spikes and use pullbacks in lagging quality names to add selectively.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
TUPRS (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +29.33%) ABOVE TREND for momentum continuation, TRALT (1W: +15.52% | 1M: +7.91%) ABOVE TREND on rerating flows, KCHOL (1W: +7.34% | 1M: +12.21%) ABOVE TREND as holding rotation, KRDMD (1W: +8.44% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND for steel demand signals, BIMAS (1W: +11.14% | 1M: +6.66%) ABOVE TREND on retail volume.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Energy & Chemicals for earnings/oil-driven moves and Retail & Food for domestic consumption signals. Holding & Investment names to monitor for portfolio rebalancing flows.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch XU100 risk-on continuation on a break above recent highs and protective support at the short-term moving averages; monitor USD/TRY moves, oil price and local CPI/CBRT comments as primary triggers. Earnings, foreign flows and geopolitical headlines remain immediate catalysts.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
RISK-ON backdrop with low volatility and concentrated leadership in Energy & Chemicals and Retail; momentum names TUPRS, TRALT and TRMET are driving the tape. Main risk is rotation into safe-haven or a sudden FX/CPI shock that would pressure lagging banks, transport and tech.
